rationale: The enumerated corpus scripts/context-strategy-check.ts guards (GEN-22). It is a committed glob list rather than 'whatever is in docs/' so two runs on the same tree give the same answer, and adding a document to the launch means adding it here. It covers every artifact the requirement names: plan and design docs, engineering specs, the work log, migration docs, launch records, agent guidelines, and the source comments of the modules that implement context sync — that last group is where a 'let's just make this read-only' note is most likely to be written and least likely to be read.
